title: Admin enablement pack: RBAC v2 + audit logging + SSO runbooks & support macros
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Create an admin enablement bundle: operator runbooks, step-by-step admin guides, and support macros to triage and resolve RBAC v2, audit logging, and SSO/SAML incidents. The goal is to reduce mean time to resolution (MTTR) for customer support and oncall teams, and to provide a consistent migration path for customers adopting RBAC v2 and private SAML configurations.
acceptance_criteria: Operator runbook covers: role troubleshooting, policy simulation, permission escalation audit, and safe rollback steps
Support macros template library for the Support team with copy-paste troubleshooting workflows for RBAC, audit logs, and SSO failures
Admin guide including RBAC v2 role mapping, CLI/REST examples, and migration checklist published in internal Confluence and linked from Console help
Triage dashboard saved view with RBAC change events, failed SAML assertions, and audit-log error rates; docs include query examples
Security review completed and signed off by Security team (audit controls and data retention guidance included)
At least two oncall runbook drills executed with drama-replay and updated postmortem notes
runbook_steps: Overview: use this when an admin reports 'unable to access project' or when audit logs show denied actions. Primary owners: Security Oncall + Platform Oncall.
Step 1 - Verify user identity and access attempt: Collect user email, timestamp (UTC), resource name, and request_id from the Console or API logs.
Step 2 - Query audit logs: run `redwoodctl audit query --user <email> --from <ts> --to <ts> --resource <res>`; if redwoodctl unavailable, use SIEM link with saved query 'RBAC_denied_events'.

Step 3 - Reproduce with policy simulator: use `redwoodctl rbac simulate --principal <user> --action <action> --resource <resource>` and record output. If simulation returns DENY, capture policy version and binding IDs.
Step 4 - Check RBAC v2 bindings: view role bindings in Console -> Security -> Roles or `redwoodctl rbac list-bindings --project <id>`. Verify inheritance and group mapping (SCIM, SAML groups).

Step 5 - If misassignment, apply least-privilege fix: create a temporary role-binding change with TTL of 1 hour using `redwoodctl rbac bind --role <role> --principal <user> --ttl 1h --note 'support temporary fix'` and notify customer. Document all changes in audit log entry and ticket.

Step 6 - For SSO/SAML failures: collect SAMLRequest/SAMLResponse from network capture or Console SSO logs. Validate time skew, certificate expiry, and ACS URL mismatch. Use `saml-tool verify --sp-entity <entity> --idp-metadata <url>` to check metadata validity.

Step 7 - Audit log integrity check: run `redwoodctl audit verify --start <ts> --end <ts>` to ensure event continuity and no gaps. If gaps found, escalate to StorageOps and include `audit-gap` incident label.

Step 8 - Rollback path: if a change to RBAC bindings caused outages across customers, invoke emergency rollback via the Admin Console 'Revert binding set' with the recorded snapshot id. Follow the emergency change checklist and notify legal/compliance if PII exposure risk exists.

Step 9 - Post-incident: add timeline to ticket, link to PRs for permanent fixes, and update runbook with exact command outputs and remediation times. Tag runbook update with 'verified-by-oncall' and date.
support_macros:
MACRO: RBAC_DENY_FIRST_STEP
Response: Hi — thanks for reporting. I can run a quick check. Can you provide your email, the project/org name, and approximate time (UTC) when the denial occurred? We'll query our audit trail and confirm the role binding status. If you prefer immediate access, we can apply a 1-hour temporary role-binding after authorization.
Steps we will perform: 1) query audit logs 2) run policy simulator 3) patch binding if approved.

MACRO: SSO_ASSERTION_FAILURE
Response: Hi — I see you had an SSO failure. Please share the exact error message from your IdP and the timestamp (UTC). We'll check SAMLResponse details and validate certificate expiry and Audience/ACS configuration. Common fixes: clock skew, expired signing cert, or incorrect ACS URL on the IdP.
If you are the admin we can re-sync IdP metadata or rotate certs after confirmation.

MACRO: AUDIT_LOG_GAP
Response: Thank you for the report. We observe a potential gap in audit events between <start> and <end>. We're running integrity verification and paging StorageOps. We'll provide an update within 60 minutes. If you are a compliance contact, please share retention requirements and we will scope recovery options.

MACRO: TEMP_ROLE_BINDING
Response: We created a temporary role binding (1h TTL) to unblock access while we investigate. Binding ID: <binding_id>. Please confirm the action you need to perform, and we'll monitor logs for activity. Reminder: temporary bindings are audited and will auto-expire.
console_examples_and_cli_commands: CLI: redwoodctl rbac simulate --principal alice@example.com --action inference:create --resource model:llama-3 --output json
Console: Security -> Audit -> Saved view: 'RBAC Deny + SAML failures' (filters: outcome=DENY OR event.type=SAML_FAILURE)
SIEM: saved-sql 'SELECT * FROM audit_events WHERE outcome='DENY' AND ts > now() - interval '1 day' ORDER BY ts DESC'
migration_checklist_for_rbac_v2: Inventory existing roles and bindings (export via `redwoodctl rbac export --format csv`)
Map legacy role permissions to RBAC v2 least-privilege roles using mapping spreadsheet (link included in 'links')
Audit group federation: verify SCIM group sync and SAML group attribute mappings
Staged rollout: RPCs to opt-in by organization, start with non-prod orgs, run telemetry for denied events
Communication: email template for customers with steps and required admin action and estimated timeline
Fallback: have automated rollback snapshot for first 72 hours post-rollout
telemetry_and_dashboard_queries: Saved view: 'RBAC Deny Rate by Org' - metric: count(audit_events where outcome='DENY') / hour per org
Alert: 'SAML assertion error rate > 5% for 10m' -> PagerDuty Security Oncall
Log query: 'index=audit_events outcome=DENY | stats count by org, role_id | sort -count'
Health check: continuous job that verifies audit pipeline latency < 60s and alerts on backlog > 10k events
rollout_plan: Phase 0 - Internal docs and training (week 1): publish runbooks, host 2-hour enablement session for Support and Oncall teams
Phase 1 - Canary customers (week 2-3): enable RBAC v2 opt-in for 5 low-risk customers, monitor deny rates and SSO failures
Phase 2 - Broad opt-in (week 4-6): gradual ramp by org size; require acceptance test passing for SCIM/SAML sync
Phase 3 - Enforcement (week 7): flip default enforcement for new orgs and auto-notify existing orgs with migration window
Communication: coordinated customer emails, support macros ready, and in-console help pointers

notes: Keep all audit queries idempotent and non-destructive. Prefer read-only CLI flags in support macros.
Temporary bindings must be created with TTL and explicit audit notes. Avoid granting org-admin unless absolutely necessary.
If customer requests a full audit export, route through Compliance and follow retention/redaction guidance.
